name: 头发动力学分析
description: 分析自然头发运动物理和一致性，以检测AI生成视频的伪影。
useCase: Detecting 深度伪造s through unnatural hair behavior and rendering 伪影
mechanism: Tracks hair strand movement, flow 模式, and physical plausibility 跨 frames. AI生成的 videos often exhibit hair that clips through solid objects, moves unrealistically, lacks natural physics simulation, or shows temporal in连贯性 in strand-level details.
accuracy: Medium-高 - 75-85% on current generation 深度伪造s
source: Verdoliva, L. (2020) - Media Forensics and DeepFakes: An Overview, IEEE JSTSP
algorithm: Hair Segmentation + Motion Field Analysis + Physical Plausibility Scoring
parameters: Segmentation model: U-Net variant, Motion estimation: dense optical flow, Physics check: gravity, inertia constraints
